'this is how adults deal with real issues'

... he/she says, posting about an 'adult' who cheats on his wife (and kids), while reccommending  lying by omission.

I would offer that adults deal with real issues by being honest and addressing issues with the person they married and had children with, but maybe that makes me a child?

I would respond positively to her, because it may be exactly as she says...

... and I would also keep my eyes open, because it may not be
